title: A new quinoline-based fluorescent-colorimetric chemosensor for sensitive and selective “on–off” detection of Pb2+ ions
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,4236-4249
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08193E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Vanshika Sharma, Srishti Dutta, Devanand Sahu, Abhilash Pandey, Dishen Kumar, Sanchita Das, Goutam Kumar Patra
A reversible fluorescent-colorimetric novel mono-Schiff base receptor for the detection of Pb2+ in aqueous medium has been developed. When exposed to Pb2+, receptor L exhibits a very good selective fluorescent-colorimetric fast on–off response.
